grade_rationale: 5 P1 findings across two specialists. Config threshold for grade C is max_p1:2; for grade D is max_p1:999. 5 P1s exceed grade-C ceiling (2). Grade is D.

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server RCE (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: Arbitrary file read and code execution when Vitest UI server is listening. Direct dependency in Source/Frontend.
escalations.impact: RCE on any environment where Vitest UI is exposed
escalations.escalation_trigger: injection risk (code execution via test UI server)

escalations.title: Handlebars.js AST Type Confusion Code Injection (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: JavaScript injection via AST type confusion when Handlebars templates process untrusted input.
escalations.impact: RCE if any backend route passes user input to Handlebars templates
escalations.fix: npm update ts-jest in Source/Backend; audit codebase for Handlebars usage with user input

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: Arbitrary code execution via unsafe.eval and prototype pollution when loading untrusted .proto files.
escalations.fix: npm install dockerode@^5.0.0 in platform/orchestrator; audit for untrusted .proto loading
escalations.escalation_trigger: injection risk (code execution via prototype pollution)

escalations.title: OpenTelemetry Completely Absent — Architecture Violation
escalations.description: Zero OTel SDK packages, no tracing, no traceparent propagation. Missing distributed tracing masks security-relevant request flows — a TheGuardians concern in addition to a TheFixer remediation task.
escalations.fix: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node, create src/tracing.ts, inject trace IDs into logger, propagate traceparent header
escalations.escalation_trigger: missing access control visibility (tracing masks auth/security flows)

p1_findings.title: Orphaned Specification — dev-workflow-platform.md (69 FRs, 0% coverage)
p1_findings.description: 69 FRs (FR-001–FR-069) describing a different application domain. Enforcer returns 76 failures. Misleads coverage metrics and agents.
p1_findings.recommendation: Archive to Specifications/archived/ or annotate as superseded. Do not leave as live spec at 0% coverage.

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search Not Wired — search.test.ts Always Fails
p1_findings.description: 5 tests in search.test.ts are self-documented as intentionally failing. Route is never registered in app.ts. DependencyPicker typeahead is broken end-to-end.
p1_findings.recommendation: Implement GET /api/search?q= in Source/Backend/src/routes/ and register in app.ts.

p2_findings.title: Route Handlers Bypass Service Layer
p2_findings.description: Both route files import and call the in-memory store directly. Architecture rule requires routes to call a service layer.

p2_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Has Three Critical Gaps
p2_findings.description: (1) Auto-targets only the most-recently-modified plan. (2) Regex misses lowercase FR-dependency-* IDs. (3) False-positive matching of domain data IDs.
p2_findings.recommendation: Fix pattern to FR-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+, add --all-plans flag, add Verifies: context guard.

p2_findings.title: Logger Always JSON — No Dev Pretty-Print Mode
p2_findings.description: No NODE_ENV check. Dev output is always machine-readable JSON, violating architecture rule and FR-WF-013.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add dev-mode pretty-print branch based on process.env.NODE_ENV.

p2_findings.description: Current version safe but update path available.

p2_findings.title: Express/qs Prototype Pollution DoS
p2_findings.description: Prototype pollution and DoS via crafted query strings.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm install express@^4.22.2 in Backend and Orchestrator.

cross_references.single_fix: Establish a weekly automated dependency update policy (Dependabot or Renovate). All 8 dependency findings are resolved by keeping dependencies current.

cross_references.root_cause: Architecture review process gap — services shipped without full architecture compliance
cross_references.single_fix: Add architecture gate to PR reviews: verify (1) no store imports in route handlers, (2) NODE_ENV branch in logger, (3) OTel initialized. All 3 P2 architecture violations are caught by one checklist addition.

Fix enforcer (QO-004) and archive orphaned spec (QO-001). The same enforcer fix that adds lowercase FR ID support will also properly track FR-dependency-seed (QO-007) and FR-dependency-api-types (QO-012).
Complete the dependency-linking feature: implement GET /api/search, add blocked_by to types, remove as any casts. One feature completion sprint resolves all 4 findings.
